cohort: The study included 150 consecutive nulliparous pregnant women whose gestational age was 41 weeks and 1-6 days and were undergoing induction of labour.
finding: An AoP wider than 100 degrees, measured before the onset of labour, is a useful sonographic parameter for predicting successful vaginal delivery among late-term nulliparous women undergoing induction of labour.
mod_finding: An AoP wider than 100 degrees was associated with a high rate of vaginal delivery compared to cesarean section among late-term nulliparous women undergoing induction of labour.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken before the onset of labour at 41 weeks and 1-6 days gestation.
